purpose: Canonical product-model inventory. This records product contracts, not proof that a particular user run produced every artifact.

artifact_kinds.label: Game Blueprint
artifact_kinds.provenance: Blueprint metadata plus source file path; generated reel strips are materialized before dependent builds.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Source-of-truth design. Editing invalidates derived outputs; a fresh validation is required before dependent materialization.

artifact_kinds.label: POKIE TypeScript game package
artifact_kinds.provenance: Package manifest and generated source retain game identity/version; a materialized Blueprint package is an implementation artifact, not a new editable Blueprint.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Runnable only when the package loader accepts its entry and dependencies. It may generate an Outcome Library only when exact enumeration is implemented.

artifact_kinds.label: Outcome Library bundle
artifact_kinds.shape: directory: manifest, per-mode index and JSONL outcomes
artifact_kinds.provenance: Manifest records library identity/hash and outcome provenance. Blueprint/package-derived libraries can be managed prerequisite projects.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Native sampling contract required for sampling, serving, simulation and exact replay. Hash/mode identity must match replay, fairness and certification consumers.

artifact_kinds.label: Stake Engine export
artifact_kinds.shape: directory: pokie-manifest.json, index.json, lookup CSV and compressed JSONL books
artifact_kinds.provenance: pokie-manifest.json identifies POKIE-produced exports. Generic Stake analysis does not require that manifest.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Read-only as an outcome source: it can be analyzed/diffed and re-exported, but it cannot be sampled, simulated, replayed or served until imported to a native Outcome Library.

artifact_kinds.label: PAR workbook
artifact_kinds.provenance: Deterministic Blueprint snapshot; import records its workbook origin in the resulting managed Blueprint registration.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Exchange-only. A workbook must be imported to a Blueprint before build, validation, simulation or runtime use.

artifact_kinds.label: POKIE WASM component
artifact_kinds.shape: WASM binary with compatible sidecar manifest
artifact_kinds.provenance: Sidecar manifest declares contract, serialization and host-binding compatibility.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Inspection-only boundary. POKIE has no WASM producer, runtime execution backend, game-logic validation or package-to-WASM compiler.

artifact_kinds.label: Runtime play session and RoundArtifact records
artifact_kinds.shape: in-memory/server session with recorded canonical round artifacts
artifact_kinds.provenance: RoundArtifact is the canonical/audit-grade record of completed play; session-local history is not a portable project artifact.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Live-package replay is best effort; outcome-library replay carries a portable exact identity.

artifact_kinds.label: Simulation report
artifact_kinds.shape: JSON report; optional rendered Markdown or HTML report
artifact_kinds.provenance: Must retain source type, seed where supplied, settings and completed result identity; a report is analysis output, not a playable project.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Outcome-library simulations are exactly replayable only with non-empty seed and matching mode/library hash. Package simulations remain runtime-dependent.

artifact_kinds.label: Replay descriptor
validates_by: RoundArtifactValidator where recorded result is present
artifact_kinds.provenance: Exact outcome replay pins library id/hash, mode, seed and round. Package replay is explicitly best effort.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Reject source/hash/mode mismatch instead of silently replaying a different outcome; the original portable descriptor is required for recovery.

artifact_kinds.label: Certification/evidence bundle
artifact_kinds.shape: directory with deterministic metrics, diagnostics and sampled/verifiable RoundArtifacts
artifact_kinds.provenance: Pins game/library hashes, source deep-validation diagnostics, metrics and sampled artifacts.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Verification requires the live source Outcome Library. Studio builds/inspects but does not expose the CLI's external verify operation.

artifact_kinds.label: Provably Fair server/round commitment
artifact_kinds.provenance: Pins client seed, nonce, library and mode before selection; server seed itself is private input, not an export artifact.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Reveal/verify require the matching commitment and live bundle; mismatch is a verification failure, never a fallback draw.

artifact_kinds.label: Provably Fair round proof
artifact_kinds.provenance: Bound to commitment hash and pinned-snapshot HMAC-SHA256 selection.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: A proof only verifies against its matching commitment and source bundle; POKIE does not provide key management, timestamping, wallet or compliance authority.

artifact_kinds.label: External deployment artifact
artifact_kinds.provenance: Target descriptor, compatibility/projection/generation/validation stages and optional delivery diagnostic.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Only registered target capabilities are eligible. POKIE ships no private RGS integration; delivery is target-owned.

artifact_kinds.label: Studio project registry entry
artifact_kinds.provenance: Local path, origin and recency only; it is not an interchange format and does not prove artifact validity after the file changes.
artifact_kinds.compatibility: Missing/unrecognized locations remain recoverable registry states. Opening must re-resolve rather than trust stale registry metadata.

non_artifact_prerequisites.purpose: registry-owned compatible Outcome Library lifecycle location
